about: max and min return the winning operand in its own unit, which sets the factor; comparing terabytes with cores does not typecheck.

files.model.yaml:
dsl: 2
model: tiny
title: max picks its unit
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  stored:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB
    value: 15
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "what is held, as stated for this case"}

  index:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: GB
    value: 500
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the index, as stated for this case"}

  disk_per_host:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: TB/host
    value: 2
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the disk each host has, as stated for this case"}

  index_tb:
    kind: derived
    unit: TB
    formula: max(stored, index)

  small_first:
    kind: derived
    unit: TB
    formula: min(index, stored)

  against_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: TB
    formula: max(stored, cores)

outputs:
  - utilisation
  - index_tb
  - small_first
  - against_cores
  - disk_per_host
files.scenarios/reference.yaml:
scenario: reference
title: Reference
because: the model as declared
samples: 1000
seed: 20260916
overrides: {}

provenance.source: the fleet chosen for this case
the disk each host has, as stated for this case
the index, as stated for this case
the busy hour, as stated for this case
processor time per request, as stated for this case
what is held, as stated for this case
